_readme: Optional captions, keyed by photo slug (the filename without extension, lower-case). Captions become the alt text and help image SEO. Anything left out falls back to a generic alt. Example: "philly-12": "Serving cheesesteaks at an evening wedding reception in Essex"
philly-6: The Philly Philly truck trading at a UK festival
philly-12: Cheesesteaks served at an evening wedding reception
philly-27: Street food catering at a corporate event
philly-33: Guests queueing at a private party booking
